description: This file defines a class for integrating AWS Kendra as a vector store and retriever within a larger system, including methods for upserting and deleting documents, and initializing retriever instances with specific configurations.

classes.name: Kendra_VectorStores
classes.description: A class implementing a Kendra vector store and retriever with methods for document upsert, delete, and initialization.

methods.name: loadMethods
methods.description: Contains method to list available AWS regions.

methods.name: vectorStoreMethods.upsert
methods.description: Method to upsert (add or update) documents into AWS Kendra index.

methods.name: vectorStoreMethods.delete
methods.description: Method to delete documents from AWS Kendra index by IDs.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes and returns a retriever or vector store based on node data inputs.
